ondc.title: ONDC
ondc.description: Offer your products on the Open Network for Digital Commerce. You choose which listings to add, and every order comes to you to accept or reject.
ondc.notLive: ONDC is not live yet. You can connect and choose listings now; nothing is shown to buyers on the network until we go live.
ondc.listingsReady: {count, plural, one {# listing ready for the network.} other {# listings ready for the network.}}
ondc.noListingsDescription: Create and publish a listing first, then add it to ONDC here.

reason.not_published: Not live yet: publish the listing first
reason.seller_unverified: Complete verification to sell on ONDC
reason.no_price: Add a price to sell on ONDC

ondc.termsText: I have read and accept the ONDC seller terms: my opted-in listings may be shown to ONDC buyer apps, orders arrive in my ONDC inbox for me to accept or reject, and if a network buyer raises an issue about my order it is handled through the network's grievance process (IGM): a dispute is opened for it, I can respond with evidence, and resolution deadlines apply.
ondc.acceptTerms: Please accept the ONDC seller terms to connect.

orders.title: ONDC orders
orders.description: Orders placed by buyers on the ONDC network. Accept or reject each one; the buyer's app is told straight away.
orders.emptyDescription: Orders from the network appear here.

issues.title: Network issues
issues.description: Problems raised by buyers on the ONDC network about your orders. Each one is handled through a dispute, and the buyer's app is kept informed.
issues.emptyDescription: Issues raised about your ONDC orders appear here.
issues.notFound: We could not find this issue, or it belongs to another business.
issues.disputeHelp: Respond and add evidence in the dispute. The outcome is sent back to the buyer's app.
issues.noDispute: No dispute is open for this issue. Our team is handling it and will send the outcome to the buyer's app.
issues.cascaded: Escalated to the next level on {when}
